name: Cityplace Market
summary: Cityplace Market is a neighborhood-focused shopping plaza in Dallas's Uptown district, featuring a practical mix of big-box retailers and dining options. The center serves as a convenient everyday shopping destination for the surrounding residential community with extended operating hours.
demographics: Cityplace Market serves the affluent Uptown Dallas neighborhood, attracting young urban professionals and families with above-average household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area draws heavily from the nearby high-rise residential developments along the Lemmon Avenue corridor, with a customer base skewing toward millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-45. Visitors demonstrate a preference for convenient, everyday shopping with an emphasis on quality groceries, health and wellness products, and quick-service dining options that fit their busy urban lifestyles.
description: Cityplace Market is a well-established community shopping center located in the heart of Dallas's vibrant Uptown district at 2417 Lemmon Avenue. This straightforward shopping plaza has become a neighborhood staple, offering residents and visitors a convenient mix of big-box retailers and dining options that cater to the daily needs of the surrounding urban community. The center's strategic location along Lemmon Avenue places it at the crossroads of some of Dallas's most desirable residential neighborhoods, making it a go-to destination for everyday shopping and services. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Cityplace Market provides extended accessibility for busy professionals and families seeking quality retailers in a no-frills, efficient shopping environment. The center has earned a solid reputation among locals, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 3,500 reviews, demonstrating its consistent ability to meet the practical shopping needs of the Uptown Dallas community.
